hero.heading: We turn traffic into pipeline, not just impressions.
hero.text: Benvor Digital builds the websites, ads, SEO, and social systems that take a business from "we should try marketing" to a predictable stream of qualified leads.

benefits.heading: Marketing that's built to be measured
benefits.text: No vanity metrics, no black boxes. Every engagement is tied back to pipeline and revenue.

items.title: Plans built on your numbers
items.text: We start with your funnel and unit economics, not a template. Every channel we recommend has a reason tied to your CAC and LTV.

items.title: Design, dev, and media in sync
items.text: Your web team and your ad team are the same team. No handoffs, no mismatched messaging between the site and the campaigns driving to it.

items.title: Live reporting, not monthly PDFs
items.text: A shared dashboard shows spend, leads, and cost‑per‑lead in real time, so you're never waiting on us to know how it's going.
